rewrites.comment: Pretty, per-supplier URLs served by one function. /venue/<slug> keeps the supplier name in the path and lets api/venue.js inject a unique <head> server-side, so crawlers never see the shared shell. Scales to any number of suppliers with no per-supplier files.
Sitemap is generated from the database so a newly published supplier appears without a deploy.

redirects.comment: Legacy stub for the original hardcoded provider page. 301 to the same supplier's new URL so old bookmarks and any accumulated link equity land on real content, not a generic list.
